finalText:
**Migration done.** I moved 36 calls across 12 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

I left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone. Its header says edits there are wiped on upgrade. Fixing it means upgrading the vendored package instead.

I did not touch `cache.query`. That one takes a cache key, not SQL.

Every file still parses. A live run showed 7 calls, all on the new form.
